# Hand Landmarker

Bundled model: `hand_landmarker.task`, float16, version 1 (7,819,105 bytes).

Downloaded from Google's published model distribution:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task

Task documentation and model card links:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker

Used by `hand-tracking-worker.js` with the existing vendored MediaPipe Tasks Vision
runtime. The installation reads this file locally; no network download at runtime.
